name: Green-Screen Short
summary: A person stands in front of a screenshot, a map or a photo that fills the whole vertical frame, and talks about it. The creator cuts out the background with the chroma-key tool of a short-video app, which TikTok added in 2020.

philosophy.core_thesis: Put the speaker in front of the evidence: the image is the set, the creator is the commentator.
design_principles: Fill the 1080 x 1920 px frame with the background image; show the speaker from the waist up at 40% to 55% of the height.
Place the speaker at the left or the right third; keep the key area of the image free.
Cut out the speaker with a clean mask with a 1 px to 2 px feather.
Add a 3 px white stroke around the speaker when the background is busy.
Zoom the image in by 110% to 130% over the clip to guide the eye.
Mark a key detail with a 6 px red circle or an arrow at 100% opacity.
Caption the speech in 40 px words at the bottom third.
anti_patterns: A speaker with a visible green fringe
A background with no link to the talk
Tiny screenshot text that nobody can read
Two speakers who hide the image

layout.grid_mechanics: Two layers: a full-bleed backdrop and a cut-out speaker on the left or right third; a caption zone at 70% to 80% of the height.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 40% to 50% of the backdrop stays visible and free of the speaker.
layout.alignment_rules: The speaker sits on a third line; captions are centred; markers align to the object they name.
layout.container_geometry: The backdrop has 0 radius; the speaker is a free-form cut-out; markers are circles of 6 px stroke.

font_pairings.note: A sturdy sans for captions over busy images.
A condensed sans for keyword tags.

hierarchy_rules: Use bold (700) for captions and medium (500) for tags.
Use a 3 px dark outline on white text so it reads on any image.
Limit a caption to 5 words per line.

color.palette_structure: The backdrop sets the colour; the UI adds one red marker, white text and black outlines.
color.contrast_rules: White text with a 3 px black outline reads on every backdrop; panel text gives 14:1.
color.surface_treatment: Photo or screenshot as a flat plate; no extra surface colour.
color.light_and_shadow: The speaker light matches the backdrop light; a 4 px soft shadow separates the cut-out edge.

materiality.surface_simulation: A screenshot or photo as a stage set, with a cut-out person in front.
materiality.border_rules: A 3 px white stroke around the speaker; no borders on the backdrop.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A 4 px drop shadow under the cut-out; no blur.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Outline 24 px icons for pointer, arrow and magnifier.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Red circles, arrows and underlines drawn over the backdrop.

motion.transition_physics: The backdrop zooms in at 110% to 130% over the clip; markers pop in over 150 ms; the backdrop changes every 5 s to 10 s.
motion.hover_and_active: A tap on a marker pauses the clip and zooms 150% on the detail.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels informed, as if a guide stands inside the story.

avoid_when: The backdrop image has no rights clearance.
The speaker cannot light the face evenly.

modifiers.how: Remove the backdrop and talk in a soft room.
Cut between 4 backdrops with speed ramps on each change.
Replace the video with a series of still slides.

pack.why: A clean outline family with pointer and arrow shapes.

ground.why: The ground is a raw, flat plate, like a screenshot that fills the frame.

tailwind.classes: rounded-none bg-[#E5322D] px-6 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white
